plan.title: RFQ bid refused after countdown ends

steps.note: Create an RFQ event for the vendor-portal expiry scenario.
Every successful create flow requires a project title.
Use an RFQ stage rather than the default auction stage.
Apply the first available RFQ pricing template.
Add one product so the RFQ bid sheet can be submitted.
Complete the RFQ pricing sheet before publishing.
Commit a valid schedule; the catalog does not provide an exact one-minute event duration.
Invite the QA vendor who will attempt the late bid.
Publish the RFQ so it is available in the vendor portal.
Confirm the event reached a real published project page.
Move to the separate vendor session while keeping the buyer session available.
Open this event’s RFQ bid sheet in the vendor portal.
Return to the buyer session to close the bidding window.
Wait for the bidding window to end naturally rather than force-ending it.
Return to the vendor portal after the event has closed.
Attempt to submit the vendor bid after closure and require positive refusal evidence.
